notes: Edit this file to update the progress page's curated sections (systems, weaknesses, critic verdicts). The evidence sections (screenshots, clips, perf, determinism, run history) are driven only by captures/*/report.json.

systems.name: Core / boot / telemetry
systems.what: Boots on npm run dev, RAF loop, frozen window.__GAUNTLET__ API (ready, frameCount, perf, player, playTape, reset, setPaused, setTimeOfDay, setHudVisible), perf telemetry, debug HUD.

systems.name: Procedural city
systems.what: Seed-deterministic InstancedMesh block grid + AnchorQuery (findSwingAnchor, raycastAnchor, surfaceHeightAt, isSolidAt). Placeholder density/layout pending city-builder polish.

systems.name: Traversal / swing
systems.what: Fixed-step pendulum solve, web attach/release, targeted dash, dive, air control. In active development by the traversal-builder.

systems.name: Camera / FX / input
systems.what: Third-person chase camera with FOV from speed, scripted tape input path, placeholder web-line + capsule FX.

systems.name: Capture & evidence harness
systems.what: tools/capture.mjs (shots, sequences, perf, determinism, tod-sweep, console gating) + tools/progress.mjs (progress page) + scripted tapes in tools/tapes/. Writes captures/<run>/report.json and captures/latest/.

weaknesses: Headless captures render through software GL (SwiftShader): frame ms is pessimistic vs a real GPU, so perf budget verdicts lean FAIL on frame time while drawCalls/triangles are real and healthy.

Placeholder traversal physics is driven by variable frame delta: exact trajectories drift between identical runs (state sequence stays stable). Determinism verdict therefore keys on the structural + visual fingerprints of the city.
City is placeholder density (InstancedMesh grid, ~2.8k blocks): triangles are far under budget by design; visual density will come from the city-builder, not from raising poly counts.
Hot-reloads during concurrent development can interrupt a capture; the harness retries interrupted operations automatically (bounded) and reports reloads in report.json.

critics.verdict: Pipeline self-test verified: node tools/capture.mjs --all runs green from a cold shell (auto-starts a stable vite server), exits 0, and writes real PNGs, mp4/gif clips and a valid report.json. Console-error gate verified to fail a deliberately broken run (injected console.error -> exit 1, recorded in report.json). Typecheck passes.
